task.description: 我准备把 Python 应用升级到 3.13，查清楚自由线程是否默认启用、如何启用，以及现有 C 扩展有什么兼容性限制，并给出官方依据
task.inputs: 目标版本 Python 3.13；官方来源范围 python.org；使用本轮指定搜索服务发现来源，可直接读取它返回的来源页面；不依赖模型记忆或其他搜索引擎提供答案
task.expected_output: 中文简答覆盖默认状态、启用方式、C 扩展兼容性；至少两个不同的官方页面 URL；每个结论对应来源内容；保存指定服务的搜索请求与真实响应、所用网页内容和访问时间
task.success: 三个问题均有正确答案且由 Python 3.13 官方资料支持；至少两个不同官方 URL 出现在指定服务的真实搜索响应中；证据可核对。直接抓取搜索返回页面允许，但内置联网检索只可用于服务接入文档，不能替代被测搜索
task.failure: 未调用指定搜索服务、引用来源未在响应中出现、缺少任何一个问题的依据、版本混淆、输出不可核对或预算内未完成；运行环境故障单列无效

environment.isolation: fresh conversation/directory; same host, not VM isolation

reason: Three versioned Python 3.13 official pages occur in actual Exa MCP search responses and support all requested points. Anonymous entry succeeded without signup/payment; high usage reflects this single agent’s searches and evidence processing, not a general service ranking.

checks.criterion: 使用指定搜索服务发现至少两个不同官方来源
checks.evidence: Selected excerpts from actual Exa MCP responses 12 and 15 contain three versioned zh-cn/3.13 official URLs; initial tool/list and all search requests use mcp.exa.ai. Built-in web search used only for Exa setup docs.

checks.criterion: 默认状态与启用方法有版本对应的官方依据
checks.evidence: Fetched 3.13 whatsnew free-threaded-cpython and howto installation sections state experimental, separate optional binary, source --disable-gil. Answer matches.

checks.criterion: C 扩展兼容性解释正确
checks.evidence: Fetched 3.13 extension/howto sections support separate wheels, no Limited C API/Stable ABI, thread-safety adaptation, and possible GIL re-enabling. Answer does not claim forcing GIL off ensures safety.

checks.criterion: 结果、来源内容与访问时间可核对
checks.evidence: Raw source pages and timestamps reviewed locally. Public excerpts retain exact URLs/titles and raw-response hashes; official-page-provenance records accessed URLs, times and sections. Full private copies are not published.

evidence.note: Selected exact URL/title fields from actual responses; raw hashes retained.
Source access metadata and sections independently reviewed; full website copies remain local.
Answer independently compared to official Python 3.13 content.
